newsitem.title: USA: Sun City in merger deal with SeaSpecialties.
newsitem.headline: Sun City in merger deal with SeaSpecialties.

text.p: Sun City Industries Inc said Friday it signed a definitive agreement to merge with privately-held SeaSpecialties Inc in a stock swap.
Sun City said Harvey Oxenberg, SeaSpecialties chairman, will either own or control 80 percent of the company, the bondholders 14 percent and the current shareholders the remaining six percent.
Sun City said, however, that there is no assurance the deal will be completed, given "the many financial problems" that confront the company.
